_comment: Schema for the receipt-per-edge worked scenario (sample-input.md): a Talus Robotics root-cause report, RCA-3309, extracted twice under two schema versions. 'edge' is the fixed shape every written edge must match, not sample data. Every edge must carry all three receipt fields (source_doc, extraction_run_id, schema_version), regardless of schema_version, or attach-receipts must refuse to write it.

edge.subject: <the entity the claim is about>
edge.object: <the entity or value the claim points to>
edge.source_doc: <the source document this edge was extracted from>
edge.extraction_run_id: <the id of the extraction run that produced this edge>
edge.schema_version: <the schema version active when this edge was written>

v1.description: Original schema. A caused-by edge carries only the bare claim plus the three receipt fields.

v2.description: Adds a required impact_scope field to every caused-by edge, naming which downstream systems the cause affected.
